For these two listings, you should buy from **Seller B - Ottervale Audio: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/nhkquk/b**

They are identical on everything that matters except for one thing:

| | **A: Brackmoor Sound** | **B: Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 - graphite | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 - graphite |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock, free standard 3-5 days | In stock, free standard 3-5 days |
| **Returns** | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping | 30-day, buyer pays return shipping |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| **Dealer Status** | Not stated | **Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.** |

They both list the same specs, box contents, price, shipping, and return policy.

The tie-breaker is that **Ottervale Audio explicitly says it is an Authorized Quellwyn dealer with Full manufacturer warranty**, while Brackmoor Sound does not.

That gives you:
1.  More confidence it's genuine / new and not grey-market or counterfeit
2.  More confidence Quellwyn will actually honor the 1-year warranty if you need a repair/replacement
3.  Less risk of warranty issues around proof-of-purchase from an unauthorized seller

Since price and everything else is the same, B is the safer buy.
